description: C1: the hold-outs and pilgrims of Last Hearth beyond the rim - Maera and her camp (members carry faction "hearthfolk"). Neutral and grateful until offended (two offences within 30 s, a blow on its people or its tents); its folk step aside for a giant at peace with them. Hostile, a respawn at its waystone moves away while its people stand within 120 m; Maera forgives for 2 iron. The seed of C4's settlement development.
warn_text: Last Hearth's folk scatter from your feet. Do that again and the camp will turn from you.
hostile_text: Last Hearth's horn sounds: the hold-outs turn from you.
stood_down_text: Last Hearth's folk lower their hunting spears.
reconciled_text: Maera takes the iron and the camp breathes again.
